raw.lot_description: The dimensions of the parcel are 25’ by 95’ (2,375 sf) and it is currently vacant.

reliefs.description: Variance Section 903.03.D.2 25’ exterior side setback required; 7’-8” requested
reliefs.quote: The Applicant’s request for a variance from Section 903.03.D.2 to allow for the construction of a single-family house on the Subject Property with a 7’-8” exterior side setback is hereby APPROVED.

raw.rationale_quote: The Applicant presented credible evidence that the 25’ width of the Subject Property is a unique characteristic of the site and that strict compliance with the Code’s 25’ exterior side setback requirement would prevent any development of it.
